---
title: "Data cleaning and processing"
output: html_document
---

## Inputs and scope

The supplied CSVs are manually collected and already standardized source tables.
This file validates those inputs, normalizes types, derives flags and units, and
recomputes summaries. It does not claim to reconstruct every original web
transcription. Career statistics represent full regular-season careers. Finals
observations represent series, not unique viewers or individual player effects.

```{r setup}
source("01_functions.R")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Import saved data

```{r import}
career <- read.csv("data/input/career_stats.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
finals <- read.csv("data/input/finals_viewership.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
jerseys <- read.csv("data/input/jersey_sales_rankings.csv",
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = "NA")
other <- read.csv("data/input/other_viewership.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

## Normalize names, types and units

Trim text and convert measurement columns explicitly. UnitsSold and RevenueUSD
remain missing because sources provide ranks, not quantities or revenue.

```{r normalize}
for (v in c("Player", "SourceID")) career[[v]] <- trimws(career[[v]])
finals$Player <- trimws(finals$Player)
for (v in c("Games", "TotalPoints", "PPG", "RPG", "APG", "FG_Pct",
            "ThreePoint_Pct", "FT_Pct")) career[[v]] <- as.numeric(career[[v]])
for (v in c("FinalsYear", "SeriesGames", "ViewersMillions")) {
  finals[[v]] <- as.numeric(finals[[v]])
}
finals$Champion <- as.logical(finals$Champion)
finals$PandemicYear <- finals$FinalsYear == 2020
finals$AverageUSViewers <- finals$ViewersMillions * 1000000
jerseys$SalesRank <- as.numeric(jerseys$SalesRank)
career <- career[order(career$Player), ]
finals <- finals[order(finals$Player, finals$FinalsYear), ]
```

## Validate observations

Do not delete valid low audience values or substitute zeros for unavailable
sales. Failure of these checks stops the workflow so an error is investigated.

```{r validation}
stopifnot(nrow(career) == 3, !anyDuplicated(career$Player))
stopifnot(nrow(finals) == 23,
          !anyDuplicated(finals[c("Player", "FinalsYear")]))
stopifnot(!anyNA(career), !anyNA(finals), all(finals$ViewersMillions > 0),
          all(finals$SeriesGames %in% 4:7), !anyNA(jerseys$SalesRank))
stopifnot(all(career$Games > 0), all(career$TotalPoints > 0))
stopifnot(all(career$FG_Pct >= 0 & career$FG_Pct <= 100))
stopifnot(all(career$ThreePoint_Pct >= 0 & career$ThreePoint_Pct <= 100))
stopifnot(all(career$FT_Pct >= 0 & career$FT_Pct <= 100))
table(finals$Player)
colSums(is.na(jerseys))
```

## Derive descriptive summaries

Each series receives equal weight. The comparison excluding 2020 is a
sensitivity analysis; 2020 remains in the main dataset.

```{r process}
summary_all <- summarize_players(finals)
summary_without_2020 <- summarize_players(subset(finals, !PandemicYear))
weighted_audience <- aggregate(
  cbind(WeightedAudience = ViewersMillions * SeriesGames,
        Games = SeriesGames) ~ Player, data = finals, FUN = sum)
weighted_audience$GameWeightedAudienceMillions <-
  weighted_audience$WeightedAudience / weighted_audience$Games
knitr::kable(summary_all, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Save outputs

```{r save}
dir.create("data/processed", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(career, "data/processed/career_stats.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(finals, "data/processed/finals_viewership.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(jerseys, "data/processed/jersey_sales_rankings.csv", row.names = FALSE,
          na = "NA")
write.csv(summary_all, "data/processed/viewership_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(summary_without_2020,
          "data/processed/viewership_without_2020.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(weighted_audience, "data/processed/weighted_viewership.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
save(career, finals, jerseys, other, summary_all, summary_without_2020,
     weighted_audience, file = "data/processed/12_CleanData.RData")
```
